widgets_values:
<----- grounding resolution (trained range 512–1536). This is a quality dial: lower = stronger edit adherence, higher = stronger identity/likeness. Try 1024+ for people, 512 for stubborn scene changes.

Get the node from [there](https://github.com/lbouaraba/comfyui-krea2edit) (I think it's not available via Comfy manager right now).

Get the identity edit LoRA from [there](https://huggingface.co/conradlocke/krea2-identity-edit/tree/main) (any of the newer ones).

value - the amount of megapixels.

ref_boost (default 1.0) — reference-fidelity dial; >1 pulls harder toward the reference's appearance, <1 loosens. 
ref_boost_a is the same dial for the scene ref in two-ref edits.

ref_boost >1 affects the speed.
restore the image quality to 4k HDR.
